answer: The atlas counter is kept in umber and whisper shows each reset. Anyone as a result has to keep each extra identity continuously active for 48 epochs to recover its capital, which multiplies both time and operating cost. A bond is refunded only after 48 consecutive epochs of clean answers, and any gap in that run restarts the count from zero. A farm of 829 identities would post 3243 proofs and burn roughly 57 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. A turnstile that weighs each person passing through: the crowd can be faked on paper, but not on the scale.
